title: Madhubani painting workshop
description: Learn the traditional Madhubani/Mithila folk painting style directly from village artists using natural dyes.

title: Pottery with Khurja artisans
description: Hands-on pottery session with generations-old ceramic artisan families known as the 'Ceramic City' of India.

title: Living root bridge trek with Khasi guide
description: Trek to living root bridges with a local Khasi guide who shares indigenous ecological knowledge.

title: Kanchipuram silk weaving visit
description: Watch and learn the intricate handloom process behind the famed Kanchipuram silk sarees.

title: Homestay with an Apatani family
description: Stay with an Apatani tribal family, share meals, and learn about their unique wet-rice-cum-fish farming.

title: Rann Utsav folk music evening
description: Evening of Kutchi folk music and dance performances under the desert sky, with local handicraft stalls.

title: Kodava cuisine cooking session
description: Cook traditional Kodava dishes like pandi curry and kadumbuttu with a local family.

title: Baluchari saree weaving demonstration
description: Watch master weavers create Baluchari sarees depicting mythological scenes on the loom.

title: Camel fair and desert camp stay
description: Experience the Pushkar Camel Fair and stay overnight in a desert camp with folk music around a bonfire.

title: Monastery morning prayers, Spiti
location: Key Monastery, Spiti Valley, Himachal Pradesh
description: Sit in on early morning prayer chants at one of the oldest Tibetan Buddhist monasteries in India.
